create_KVCachingTransformerLM: create a KVCachingTransformerLM from an uncached TransformerLM with specified cache length and batch axes
run_KVCachingTransformerLM_call: run KVCachingTransformerLM with token inputs to produce logits while updating the KV cache state
convert_attention_to_kv_caching: convert Attention layers in a TransformerLM to KVCachingAttention with causal mask support
fix_attention_mask_positions: fix attention mask layers to use kv_token_positions instead of token_positions for caching
initialize_kv_cache_state: initialize key-value cache state variables with zeroed previous tokens and cache end index
